entities.name: Q19969 IMA-3
observations: Exact 514-aa sequence match to reviewed Caenorhabditis elegans importin subunit alpha-3 (UniProt Q19969); 100% identity and coverage, E-value 2.18e-250.
Importin-alpha adapter that binds simple and bipartite nuclear localization signals and partners with importin-beta for nuclear protein import.
Annotated in cytoplasm, nucleus, nuclear envelope, and nuclear pore; Pfam detects an N-terminal IBB domain and repeated armadillo domains.
Predicted sequence properties: 56.2 kDa, pI 4.69, GRAVY -0.103; no catalytic reaction retrieved.

entities.name: NLS-dependent nuclear import
observations: IMA-3/importin-alpha recognizes nuclear localization signals and functions with importin-beta in nuclear protein import.
